mapper.select: select count(*) from sys_dict_type type join sys_dict_data data on data.dict_type=type.dict_type where type.dict_type=#{dictType} and data.dict_value=#{dictValue} and type.status='0' and data.status='0'
select r.*, (select count(*) from todo_template_draft_rule_ref ref where ref.ref_type='SLA' and ref.ref_id_value=r.sla_rule_id) reference_count from todo_sla_rule r where r.sla_rule_id=#{id}
mapper.insert: insert into todo_sla_rule(rule_code,rule_name,sla_type,duration_value,duration_unit,calendar_code,start_strategy, soft_remind_percent,hard_remind_percent,escalate_percent,pause_policy_json,escalation_policy_json,auto_action_json, status,create_by) values(#{ruleCode},#{ruleName},#{slaType},#{durationValue},#{durationUnit},#{calendarCode},#{startStrategy}, #{softRemindPercent},#{hardRemindPercent},#{escalatePercent},cast(#{pausePolicyJson} as json), cast(#{escalationPolicyJson} as json),cast(#{autoActionJson} as json),coalesce(#{status},'0'),#{createBy})
mapper.select: select count(*) from todo_template_draft_rule_ref where ref_type='SLA' and ref_id_value=#{id}
select r.*, (select count(*) from todo_template_draft_rule_ref ref where ref.ref_type='DOD' and ref.ref_id_value=r.dod_rule_id) reference_count from todo_dod_rule r where r.dod_rule_id=#{id}
mapper.insert: insert into todo_dod_rule(rule_code,rule_name,rule_type,required_fields_json,required_attachments_json, conditional_rules_json,validator_refs_json,error_messages_json,status,create_by) values(#{ruleCode},#{ruleName},#{ruleType},cast(#{requiredFieldsJson} as json),cast(#{requiredAttachmentsJson} as json), cast(#{conditionalRulesJson} as json),cast(#{validatorRefsJson} as json),cast(#{errorMessagesJson} as json), coalesce(#{status},'0'),#{createBy})
mapper.update: update todo_dod_rule set rule_code=#{ruleCode},rule_name=#{ruleName},rule_type=#{ruleType}, required_fields_json=cast(#{requiredFieldsJson} as json),required_attachments_json=cast(#{requiredAttachmentsJson} as json), conditional_rules_json=cast(#{conditionalRulesJson} as json),validator_refs_json=cast(#{validatorRefsJson} as json), error_messages_json=cast(#{errorMessagesJson} as json),status=#{status},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where dod_rule_id=#{dodRuleId} and version=#{expectedVersion}
update todo_dod_rule set status=#{status},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where dod_rule_id=#{dodRuleId} and version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: select count(*) from todo_template_draft_rule_ref where ref_type='DOD' and ref_id_value=#{id}

select ref.*, case when ref.ref_type='SLA' then sla.rule_code when ref.ref_type='DOD' then dod.rule_code else null end rule_code, case when ref.ref_type='SLA' then sla.rule_name when ref.ref_type='DOD' then dod.rule_name else null end rule_name, case when ref.ref_type='SLA' then sla.status when ref.ref_type='DOD' then dod.status else null end rule_status from todo_template_draft_rule_ref ref left join todo_sla_rule sla on ref.ref_type='SLA' and sla.sla_rule_id=ref.ref_id_value left join todo_dod_rule dod on ref.ref_type='DOD' and dod.dod_rule_id=ref.ref_id_value where ref.version_id=#{versionId} order by ref.ref_type,ref.sort_order,ref.ref_id

select t.*,draft.version_id draft_version_id,draft.status draft_status,draft.version_no draft_version_no, published.version_id published_version_id,published.version_no published_version_no,published.published_time from todo_template t left join todo_template_version draft on draft.version_id=( select candidate.version_id from todo_template_version candidate where candidate.template_id=t.template_id and candidate.status in ('DRAFT','BLOCKED') order by candidate.version_no desc,candidate.version_id desc limit 1) left join todo_template_version published on published.version_id=( select candidate.version_id from todo_template_version candidate where candidate.template_id=t.template_id and candidate.status='PUBLISHED' order by candidate.version_no desc,candidate.version_id desc limit 1) where t.template_id=#{templateId}
mapper.insert: insert into todo_simulation_record(request_id,template_version_id,event_type,business_type,business_id,input_summary_json, result_json,duration_ms,operator_id) values(#{requestId},#{templateVersionId},#{eventType},#{businessType},#{businessId},cast(#{inputSummaryJson} as json), cast(#{resultJson} as json),#{durationMs},#{operatorId})
